result.summary: The image depicts a well-maintained urban intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. While infrastructure like sidewalks and a green-painted bike lane are present, the multi-lane configuration creates a relatively long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway across multiple lanes increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the entire width of the street.

hazards.name: Multiple-threat risk
hazards.description: With multiple travel lanes in the same direction, a pedestrian may be visible to one driver but obscured to another in an adjacent lane.
hazards.location_in_image: The three travel lanes approaching the crosswalk from the background.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps with tactile warnings, and signalization. However, the crosswalk markings are severely faded, and the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increases pedestrian exposure in a high-density urban environment.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of physical protection
hazards.description: The wide corner radius and lack of curb extensions increase the distance pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Apply durable, high-visibility thermoplastic markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a well-maintained urban intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and a green-painted bike lane. The environment includes wide sidewalks and curb ramps with tactile warning pads, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians.

hazards.name: Multi-lane one-way traffic
hazards.description: One-way streets with multiple lanes can encourage higher vehicle speeds and create multiple-threat crash scenarios at crossings.

hazards.name: Unprotected bike lane
hazards.description: The bike lane is only separated by paint, which does not prevent vehicle encroachment into the cyclist's path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and increase visibility.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical vertical separation such as bollards or planters to the existing bike lane.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to act as a speed table and prioritize pedestrian movement.

result.summary: The image shows a standard urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. The environment features wide sidewalks and clear sightlines, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic across multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.
